content: Kakaɨyari, meripaitɨ katiniwakuxaxatɨwakaitɨni tapaapama, Kakaɨyari niukametemama yametekuxatakaku, yuxexuitɨ kememɨte'upitɨarie niuki yɨkɨ mɨ'anene hepaɨtsita.
Hikɨ tukari taparirɨmekaku pɨtatiutaxatɨa tame, kemɨ'ane nu'aya mɨhɨkɨ pɨta yatikuxatakaku. Mɨkɨ yuniwe kaniukayeni hetsiena mɨtinakenikɨ naitɨ, mɨkɨ hetsie Kakaɨyari tita 'amɨtikuma katiniunetɨani.

Mɨkɨ hetsie Kakaɨyari kemɨtixawatɨ kanimatsiɨkɨni meta kemɨtimariwe, Kakaɨyari kani'inɨarieyatɨni kaniyuritɨni. Naime meta pɨratɨkɨ yuniuki mɨtɨrɨkaɨyekɨ, mɨkɨ yɨkɨmana 'aixɨa 'iyurieka tita 'axatemɨte'uyuri hepaɨtsita mɨtatsi'itienikɨ, 'ana kemɨ'ane mɨmariwe tserieta kanayerɨni muyuawitsie.
Nu'aya pumariwe, niuki tuayamete taheima miemete hepaɨna mekamamariwawekaku
Mɨkɨ kaniupitɨarieni yemekɨ mɨmariwanikɨ kemɨ'ane mɨhɨkɨ, peru taheima miemete niuki tuayamete hepaɨna mepɨkate'upitɨarie, yaxeikɨata mariwetɨ kanayani, mɨkɨ hepaɨna mekamamariwawekaku.
¿Kakaɨyari kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ pɨtiutahɨawixɨ niuki tuayamete xeime heiwa:
Matsi tukari hepaɨtsita tikuxatatɨ kepauka kwiepa mi'atɨani yumatɨari mɨpaɨ pɨta kanaineni:

content.text: «Yunaitɨ Kakaɨyari hetsɨa miemete niuki tuayamete meke'eyexeiyani».
kanixeuraɨyeni 'a'itsɨ pemakwe'e pemɨti'aitamekɨ 'inɨari kanihɨkɨtɨni heitseriemekɨ kepemɨtikamie 'ekɨ.
Pepinaki'erie tita mɨtiheitserie, pepi'uxiwe'erie tita 'aitsika mɨtititsana,
Kakaɨyari 'aku kemɨ'ane mɨ'akakaɨyari pɨmatsi'anayexei, temawierika metsipitɨatɨ,

content: ¿Keri hatsuaku titahɨawiwe niuki tuayamete xeime mɨpaɨ tikɨhɨawetɨ:
¿Kamɨtsɨ niuki tuayamete yunaitɨ 'iyarite mekatehɨkɨ, Kakaɨyari memɨte'uximayatsiriwamete, memɨtanɨ'ariwa memɨwaparewienikɨ kemɨ'ane wahetsie mɨtinakirɨme memɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ?
